column1: # City Folk fish and bugs ac-plus adds (pc/tools/cf_creatures.py): those the GameCube has none of. (emperor, miyama stag,
# black bass and char are the GameCube's purple butterfly, mountain beetle, bass and large char.)
# Item: fish 0x2330 + slot, bugs 0x2D30 + slot; put in the house: furniture 0x3C00 + 4 * n (fish first, then bugs).
# months/hours when they come out (hours from-to, wrapping past midnight, comma for several; all); place: where the
# GameCube's own spawn tables would have them; weight: on those tables' scale; base: fish, the size (XS S M L XL) and
# bite as the GameCube's fish of that size; bugs, the GameCube's bug it moves and is caught like; file: Fish/ or
# Insect/ on the disc; placed: Item/Fish/FishN or Item/Insect/InsectN; size: a bug's half width in town (0 for fish).
# line: its catch line in City Folk's sys_MESS/SYS_Get_fish.bmg or SYS_Get_bug.bmg (for a fish, Chip's in npc_SP/NPC_uomasa.bmg is 100 on).
